title: Ash and Pikachu Dargo brick set
caption:
Ash and Pikachu Dargo brick set

Dargo packaged Ash and Pikachu as brick figures in its unlicensed Pokémon GO line, photographed in a 2016 collector review. The box is trying very hard to look official. The little faces are doing their own thing.

title: Squirtle and Pikachu Dargo brick set
caption:
Squirtle and Pikachu Dargo brick set

This Dargo box pairs its blocky trainer with Squirtle and Pikachu, part of the same bootleg brick-figure run documented in 2016. Squirtle appears to have been assembled from memory, several years after anyone saw Squirtle.

title: Gengar Locking Ouija Board Stash Box
caption:
Gengar Locking Ouija Board Stash Box

Overcast Oddities collaborated with CarvedWithLight on a Gengar stash box; moving the planchette to spell HEX unlocks it. A regular key was apparently insufficiently haunted. 🔐

title: Centiskorch Pokemon 15 x 7  Shadow Box
caption:
Centiskorch Pokemon 15 x 7  Shadow Box

Overcast Oddities makes this Centiskorch as a handmade faux specimen inside a long shadowbox. I respect any bug that requires its own panoramic frame.

title: Sizzlipede Pokemon 5 x 7 Shadow Box
caption:
Sizzlipede Pokemon 5 x 7 Shadow Box

Their Sizzlipede gets a smaller specimen frame, like the junior entry in a very questionable museum collection. Adorable, if your idea of adorable has six legs and a temperature warning.

title: Houndoom Pokemon Skull Coffin Terrarium
caption:
Houndoom Pokemon Skull Coffin Terrarium

Overcast Oddities puts a Houndoom skull in a coffin-shaped terrarium with tiny scenery around it. Somebody looked at Houndoom and thought: what if the decor were even more metal? 🖤

title: Mimikyu Tail Pokemon 5 x 7 Shadow Box
caption:
Mimikyu Tail Pokemon 5 x 7 Shadow Box

This handmade Mimikyu tail sits in a shadowbox, presented like a piece recovered from a creature that does not want to be identified. I would absolutely leave the lights on near this one.

title: Pikachu Skull Pokemon Geometric Terrarium
caption:
Pikachu Skull Pokemon Geometric Terrarium

A Pikachu skull becomes the centerpiece of Overcast Oddities' geometric terrarium; the plants and crystals vary with each handmade piece. Pikachu's dental records are going to raise questions.

title: Latios & Latias - Pokemon - 8x10 Shadow Box
caption:
Latios & Latias - Pokemon - 8x10 Shadow Box

Latios and Latias appear together in this handmade shadowbox from Overcast Oddities. Finally, a sibling portrait that looks like it belongs in a natural history wing.

title: Mudkip Pokemon Skull Geometric Terrarium
caption:
Mudkip Pokemon Skull Geometric Terrarium

This geometric terrarium frames a handmade Mudkip skull rather than the usual smiling Mudkip plush. The little guy got a whole archaeological exhibit. He would probably still say mudkip.

title: Surskit Pokemon 6x6 Shadow Box
caption:
Surskit Pokemon 6x6 Shadow Box

Overcast Oddities mounts Surskit in a glass shadowbox as a faux specimen. A pond skater with a gallery wall career. Good for Surskit.

title: Politoed Pokemon Geometric Terrarium
caption:
Politoed Pokemon Geometric Terrarium

Politoed gets a miniature habitat inside one of Overcast Oddities' handmade geometric terrariums. The frog looks like he owns the property and charges rent. 🐸

title: Absol Pokemon Skull Terrarium
caption:
Absol Pokemon Skull Terrarium

Overcast Oddities builds a skull terrarium around Absol, the Pokémon everyone blames when something goes wrong. Framing the evidence seems a little unfair to Absol.

title: Butterfree Lovers - Pokémon 9x9 Shadow Box
caption:
Butterfree Lovers - Pokémon 9x9 Shadow Box

Two Butterfree become a paired shadowbox piece by Overcast Oddities, made as faux natural-history art. Even the pretend museum has a romance department.

title: Medium Glass Dome Pokemon Skull Ornament
caption:
Medium Glass Dome Pokemon Skull Ornament

The maker also sells glass-dome skull ornaments, turning its Pokémon fossil idea into something you can hang up. Nothing says festive like an unidentified cranial specimen.

title: Mini Cubone Skull Pokémon Ornament
caption:
Mini Cubone Skull Pokémon Ornament

This miniature Cubone skull ornament is one of Overcast Oddities' handmade pieces. Cubone already had a skull situation. Now it also has holiday decor.

title: Golbat Coffin Terrarium
caption:
Golbat Coffin Terrarium

A Golbat is staged inside a coffin-shaped terrarium by Overcast Oddities. Honestly, this is the first coffin display Golbat has ever truly earned. 🦇

title: Crobat Coffin Terrarium
caption:
Crobat Coffin Terrarium

Crobat gets the companion coffin-terrarium treatment in the same artist's catalog. Four wings, one coffin, and still somehow not enough personal space.

title: Joltik Pokémon Mini Terrarium
caption:
Joltik Pokémon Mini Terrarium

Overcast Oddities shrinks Joltik's habitat into a tiny handmade terrarium. The world's smallest roommate, provided you don't count your electric bill.

title: Crobat Pokemon Skeleton - 8x10 Shadowbox
caption:
Crobat Pokemon Skeleton - 8x10 Shadowbox

This Crobat skeleton is mounted in an 8-by-10 shadowbox like a field specimen. Four-winged anatomy suddenly feels like a final exam question.

title: Kleavor Pokemon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Kleavor Pokemon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Overcast Oddities builds a handmade Kleavor faux-taxidermy piece behind glass. A fossil-era battle axe bug on your wall. Sure, why not.

title: Gyarados Skull Terrarium
caption:
Gyarados Skull Terrarium

A Gyarados skull anchors this terrarium instead of the giant blue sea serpent itself. It still looks ready to ruin a fishing trip.

title: Lugia & Ho-oh Pokemon Skulls Terrarium
caption:
Lugia & Ho-oh Pokemon Skulls Terrarium

The maker puts Lugia and Ho-Oh skulls together in one terrarium, a physical fan interpretation of the two legendary birds. Imagine being the museum employee asked to label this case.

title: Kanto Starters Skull Terrarium
caption:
Kanto Starters Skull Terrarium

Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle get represented as skulls in this Kanto-starter terrarium. Professor Oak's selection table has taken a dark turn.

title: Legendary Beasts Pokemon Skulls Terrarium
caption:
Legendary Beasts Pokemon Skulls Terrarium

Overcast Oddities gives the legendary beasts a shared skull display. That is a lot of mythological bone structure for one shelf.

title: Zubat Coffin Terrarium
caption:
Zubat Coffin Terrarium

Zubat gets a coffin terrarium too, built by the same handmade oddities shop. It finally found somewhere to hang out that isn't directly in my face.

title: Seviper Pokemon Terrarium
caption:
Seviper Pokemon Terrarium

Seviper coils through a small handmade terrarium in Overcast Oddities' Pokémon line. A snake in a display case is either a collection or an extremely polite warning. 🐍

title: Limited Edition: Pride Butterfree Pokémon 5x5 Shadow box - Supporting OneNTen
caption:
Limited Edition: Pride Butterfree Pokémon 5x5 Shadow box - Supporting OneNTen

This Pride Butterfree shadowbox was offered by Overcast Oddities with profits designated for one•n•ten, an Arizona organization supporting LGBTQ+ young people. Butterfree understood the assignment. 🦋🏳️‍🌈

title: Special Edition: Pride Butterfree Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Special Edition: Pride Butterfree Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

The artist made a separate Pride Butterfree faux-taxidermy edition as part of the same physical art line. The most colorful specimen in a museum that was already pretty weird.

title: Arbok Pokemon Terrarium
caption:
Arbok Pokemon Terrarium

Arbok gets a custom miniature habitat in an Overcast Oddities terrarium. I would not put this next to the houseplants that already look nervous.

title: Golbat Pokemon Skeleton - 8 x 10
caption:
Golbat Pokemon Skeleton - 8 x 10

This Golbat skeleton is another handmade shadowbox specimen from Overcast Oddities. The wingspan says “educational.” The teeth say “absolutely not.”

title: Odd Keystone Pokémon Mini Terrarium [Vault Item]
caption:
Odd Keystone Pokémon Mini Terrarium [Vault Item]

Odd Keystone appears in a mini terrarium listed among the maker's vault pieces. A decorative rock with Spiritomb implications. Very relaxing home accent.

title: Unown Pokémon Alphabet Tiles Display - 8 x 10 [Vault Item]
caption:
Unown Pokémon Alphabet Tiles Display - 8 x 10 [Vault Item]

Overcast Oddities arranged Unown as physical alphabet tiles inside a framed display. At last, wall art that may or may not be spelling a threat.

title: Gengar Jack-O'-Lantern Pokémon Mini Terrarium [Vault Item]
caption:
Gengar Jack-O'-Lantern Pokémon Mini Terrarium [Vault Item]

The artist put a Gengar jack-o'-lantern scene in a tiny terrarium. It looks ready to haunt the porch and steal the candy.

title: Bulbasaur and Pikachu Dargo brick set
caption:
Bulbasaur and Pikachu Dargo brick set

This Dargo package adds Bulbasaur and Pikachu to its unlicensed brick-figure lineup, documented in the 2016 review. The logo knows exactly what it wants to be when it grows up.

title: Pokémon Tarot Wood Hanging Display
caption:
Pokémon Tarot Wood Hanging Display

Overcast Oddities assembled this hanging wooden display for Pokémon tarot pieces by hand. I pulled the Gengar card. It says I need to stop buying Gengar things.

title: Magikarp Skeleton Pokémon Taxidermy Shadowbox 5x7
caption:
Magikarp Skeleton Pokémon Taxidermy Shadowbox 5x7

A Magikarp skeleton is framed as faux taxidermy by Overcast Oddities. Somehow the bones are still doing Splash and accomplishing nothing.

title: Kingler Pokémon Shadowbox 5x7
caption:
Kingler Pokémon Shadowbox 5x7

Kingler becomes a shadowbox specimen in the maker's handmade collection. It looks like a seafood restaurant hired a curator.

title: Butterfree Evolution Taxidermy - 15x7 Shadowbox
caption:
Butterfree Evolution Taxidermy - 15x7 Shadowbox

This long shadowbox presents the Butterfree evolution line as a sequence of faux specimens. The caterpillar-to-butterfly lesson got unexpectedly Pokémon specific. 🐛

title: Butterfree Pokémon Enamel Pin
caption:
Butterfree Pokémon Enamel Pin

Overcast Oddities turned its Butterfree specimen idea into a physical enamel pin. Now the tiny museum exhibit can travel on your jacket.

title: Pokémon Taxidermy Prints - 7x7
caption:
Pokémon Taxidermy Prints - 7x7

The maker also printed its Pokémon taxidermy designs as small physical art prints. For anyone who wants a specimen wall without installing a specimen wall.

title: Gengar Skull Pokémon Terrarium
caption:
Gengar Skull Pokémon Terrarium

A handmade Gengar skull sits in a terrarium by Overcast Oddities. Gengar has always smiled like it knows where the other skulls went.

title: Solrock & Lunatone Pokémon Taxidermy - 8x10 Shadow box [Vault Item]
caption:
Solrock & Lunatone Pokémon Taxidermy - 8x10 Shadow box [Vault Item]

Solrock and Lunatone share a framed faux-taxidermy display from the artist's vault collection. I have no idea what their skeletons should look like, and apparently nobody stopped the artist either.

title: Combee Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Combee Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Combee is mounted behind glass as a specimen-style art piece. The bee union has filed a complaint about the framing.

title: Vivillon Pokémon Shadowbox - 6x6
caption:
Vivillon Pokémon Shadowbox - 6x6

Vivillon's wing patterns become the focus of this physical shadowbox. A Pokémon that was practically designed to make butterfly collectors lose their minds.

title: Vikavolt Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox [Vault Item]
caption:
Vikavolt Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox [Vault Item]

Overcast Oddities made a Vikavolt faux-taxidermy shadowbox, listed among its vault items. This one looks like it could chew through the frame if given a weekend.

title: Zubat Skeleton Sculpture - Pokémon - 8x10 Shadowbox
caption:
Zubat Skeleton Sculpture - Pokémon - 8x10 Shadowbox

A handmade Zubat skeleton hangs inside a framed display rather than a cave. Somehow this is still less startling than encountering thirty of them in a row.

title: Snom Pokémon Taxidermy - 4x3 Shadowbox
caption:
Snom Pokémon Taxidermy - 4x3 Shadowbox

Snom gets a tiny 4-by-3 specimen frame from Overcast Oddities. The museum's smallest exhibit is also the one I would protect with my life.

title: Volcarona Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Volcarona Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Volcarona is posed as a large moth specimen behind glass. Finally, a moth worthy of its own dramatic lighting.

title: Staryu Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Staryu Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Staryu gets the faux-taxidermy treatment, complete with a collector-style display. The anatomy lesson is going to be complicated by its complete lack of a face.

title: Shedinja Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Shedinja Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Shedinja becomes a framed specimen, which is funny because the Pokémon is already an empty shed shell. This may be the most technically appropriate piece in the entire shop.

title: Scizor Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Scizor Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Scizor is pinned into the artist's specimen-display format. I assume the person hanging it checks the frame latches twice.

title: Venomoth Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Venomoth Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Venomoth lands in a handmade faux-taxidermy shadowbox. A moth with poison powers deserves a little warning plaque.

title: Starmie Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Starmie Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Starmie is displayed as a specimen next to the maker's Staryu piece. Evolution has turned the museum starfish into a decorative weapon.

title: Spinarak Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Spinarak Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

A Spinarak specimen hangs behind glass in this handmade shadowbox. I can handle a fake spider. I just need someone else to hang it. 🕷️

title: Dustox Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Dustox Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Dustox gets its own framed faux-taxidermy treatment from Overcast Oddities. For once the thing flying around your lamp comes with a proper label.

title: Scyther Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Scyther Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Scyther is rendered as a pinned natural-history specimen. Those scythe arms make this a brave choice for wall decor.

title: Frosmoth Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Frosmoth Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Frosmoth gets the same museum treatment, with pale wings spread inside the frame. A very elegant way to remember your sweater is covered in moth holes.

title: Heracross Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Heracross Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Heracross becomes a mounted beetle specimen in the artist's handmade series. The horn makes it look like it was promoted to management.

title: Butterfree Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Butterfree Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Butterfree is shown as a faux butterfly specimen behind glass. Childhood bug catching has become interior design.

title: Beedrill Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Beedrill Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Beedrill gets pinned into a handmade shadowbox like a giant wasp exhibit. This frame is staying on the far side of the room.

title: Beautifly Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Beautifly Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Beautifly takes the butterfly-display approach into Pokémon territory. If it were real, the collector would need a much bigger net.

title: Charmander and Pikachu Dargo brick set
caption:
Charmander and Pikachu Dargo brick set

Dargo's Charmander-and-Pikachu box rounds out another photographed part of its 2016 bootleg brick run. Charmander's flame survived the redesign. That's about all I can guarantee.

title: Cubone Skull Sticker
caption:
Cubone Skull Sticker

Overcast Oddities made a physical waterproof sticker from its Cubone-skull motif. A tiny reminder that Cubone's lore was never especially cheerful.

title: Mewtwo Pokémon Skull Terrarium
caption:
Mewtwo Pokémon Skull Terrarium

This artist's Mewtwo skull terrarium asks what a psychic legend might leave behind. I would like to know who was brave enough to excavate it.

title: Staryu Pokémon Beach Terrarium
caption:
Staryu Pokémon Beach Terrarium

Staryu gets a beach habitat in a handmade terrarium by Overcast Oddities. A vacation home for a starfish that can fire a laser.

title: Cubone Skull Geometric Terrarium
caption:
Cubone Skull Geometric Terrarium

Another geometric terrarium puts Cubone's skull front and center. Cubone's backstory is somehow now a conversation piece for the coffee table.

title: Gastly Pokémon in a Bottle
caption:
Gastly Pokémon in a Bottle

The maker sealed a little Gastly sculpture inside a glass bottle. Catching a ghost this way seems legally questionable, but the shelf appeal is strong.

title: Butterfree Lovers Pokémon Terrarium
caption:
Butterfree Lovers Pokémon Terrarium

Two Butterfree share a terrarium scene rather than a specimen frame. A considerably nicer ending for the butterflies than a pin through the thorax.

title: Masquerain Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox
caption:
Masquerain Pokémon Taxidermy - 6x6 Shadowbox

Masquerain gets a faux-taxidermy shadowbox in the artist's bug lineup. It looks like a museum exhibit that could glide away when nobody is watching.

title: Dustox Pokémon Terrarium
caption:
Dustox Pokémon Terrarium

Dustox also has a terrarium version, staged among miniature scenery. The moth got an apartment after its museum portrait.

title: Leafeon Terrarium (Large)
caption:
Leafeon Terrarium (Large)

Fandom Garden built a large Leafeon terrarium with a forest floor, little pond, and handmade mushrooms. Leafeon has better landscaping than most actual houses.

title: Snivy Terrarium (Large)
caption:
Snivy Terrarium (Large)

This large Snivy scene comes from Fandom Garden's handmade Pokémon terrarium collection. The tiny snake has the posture of someone inspecting the gardener's work.

title: Venusaur Terrarium (Large)
caption:
Venusaur Terrarium (Large)

Fandom Garden gave Venusaur a planted miniature habitat of its own. At this point the Pokémon is basically the landscaping contractor.

title: Bulbasaur Terrarium (Large)
caption:
Bulbasaur Terrarium (Large)

Bulbasaur gets a garden-scale terrarium from the same maker. A small plant creature in a small plant world. Honestly, the math checks out.

title: Eevee - Christmas Scene
caption:
Eevee - Christmas Scene

Fandom Garden made an Eevee Christmas scene inside a display dome. The decorations are cute. Eevee is still probably eating one. 🎄

title: Noibat
caption:
Noibat

A Noibat is tucked into one of the maker's handmade miniature scenes. If the display starts making ultrasonic noises, I'm leaving.

title: Eevee and Pikachu - Christmas Scene
caption:
Eevee and Pikachu - Christmas Scene

Eevee and Pikachu share a festive holiday terrarium by Fandom Garden. The holiday card practically assembled itself.

title: Pikachu - Christmas Scene
caption:
Pikachu - Christmas Scene

Pikachu gets a separate Christmas display from the same maker. I hope somebody insulated those tiny string lights.

title: Vulpix Fall Terrarium
caption:
Vulpix Fall Terrarium

Fandom Garden staged a sleeping Vulpix in an autumn forest inside a sealed four-inch terrarium. This is the sort of fall decoration that makes the pumpkin jealous. 🍂

title: Pikachu Forest Terrarium
caption:
Pikachu Forest Terrarium

A forest scene gives Pikachu its own small habitat. I wonder how many tiny mushrooms have been electrocuted.

title: Snorlax Terrarium
caption:
Snorlax Terrarium

Snorlax is placed in a miniature terrarium by Fandom Garden. Finally, a habitat with a floor plan that says “nap.”

title: Vulpix (Alolan) Terrarium
caption:
Vulpix (Alolan) Terrarium

Alolan Vulpix gets its own pale, wintry miniature environment. Regular Vulpix got fall; its cousin demanded colder weather.

title: Lucario Terrarium
caption:
Lucario Terrarium

Fandom Garden built a little landscape around Lucario. It looks like Lucario is supervising a martial arts retreat for moss.

title: Jolteon River Terrarium
caption:
Jolteon River Terrarium

Jolteon sits beside a tiny river in one of the maker's Pokémon scenes. Water and electricity together. Lovely, completely reassuring design choice.

title: Pikachu Fighting Terrarium
caption:
Pikachu Fighting Terrarium

This Pikachu scene stages the little guy in a fighting pose instead of another cute nap. The miniature plants are about to witness a problem.

title: Pikachu Grass Terrarium (Lying Male)
caption:
Pikachu Grass Terrarium (Lying Male)

Fandom Garden offers a lying-down Pikachu in a grassy display. It has decided the battle can start after lunch.

title: Pikachu Grass Terrarium (Sitting Male)
caption:
Pikachu Grass Terrarium (Sitting Male)

A sitting Pikachu gets the companion grassy terrarium treatment. Same field, different level of enthusiasm.

title: Vulpix Terrarium
caption:
Vulpix Terrarium

This Vulpix terrarium is a separate woodland take from Fandom Garden. Nine tails are an ambitious amount of furniture for a four-inch scene.

title: Eevee River Terrarium
caption:
Eevee River Terrarium

Eevee gets a riverbank landscape in the maker's handmade series. It has eight possible futures and apparently chose waterfront property.

title: Charmander Fighting Terrarium
caption:
Charmander Fighting Terrarium

Charmander is posed for battle in a contained miniature habitat. That tiny forest may want to update its fire policy.

title: Vaporeon River Terrarium
caption:
Vaporeon River Terrarium

Vaporeon belongs by the water, so Fandom Garden built it a river scene. For once an Eeveelution got a floor plan tailored to the tenant.

title: Flareon River Terrarium
caption:
Flareon River Terrarium

Flareon gets a river landscape too. It looks lovely, although I suspect Flareon requested a warmer room.

title: Charmander Terrarium
caption:
Charmander Terrarium

A more relaxed Charmander occupies this handmade terrarium. Keeping the miniature foliage away from the tail is the whole job.

title: Ditto-Pikachu Terrarium
caption:
Ditto-Pikachu Terrarium

Fandom Garden put a Ditto-Pikachu and a sleeping Ditto together in a grassy scene with handmade mushrooms. One of them is pretending. Maybe both of them are. 💜

title: Ditto-Leafeon Terrarium
caption:
Ditto-Leafeon Terrarium

Ditto-Leafeon gets its own small garden scene. A plant Pokémon impersonation is a surprisingly efficient way to blend into the shrubbery.

title: Eevee Terrarium
caption:
Eevee Terrarium

Eevee stars in another standalone terrarium from the maker. There are many possible evolutions; right now it is evolving into a homeowner.

title: Blastoise Terrarium - Large
caption:
Blastoise Terrarium - Large

A large Blastoise scene gives the water-type more space than the usual tiny dome. The water bill for this little property must be serious.

title: Scorbunny Terrarium - Large
caption:
Scorbunny Terrarium - Large

Scorbunny takes over one of Fandom Garden's large displays. A rabbit with this much energy probably needed the extra acreage.

title: Vulpix Terrarium - Large
caption:
Vulpix Terrarium - Large

The maker also built a larger Vulpix environment with autumn color. Nine tails, peak foliage, absolutely no parking available.

title: Mew Terrarium - Large
caption:
Mew Terrarium - Large

Mew gets a spacious miniature landscape in Fandom Garden's large format. An extremely rare Pokémon now has a very ordinary domestic concern: lawn care.

title: [ROSE GOLD] [PINK BLUSH] PSYDUCK & LOTAD  [POKEBUDDIES]  ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[ROSE GOLD] [PINK BLUSH] PSYDUCK & LOTAD  [POKEBUDDIES]  ENAMEL PIN

MAMOBOT made this rose-gold Psyduck and Lotad enamel pin in its PokéBuddies series. One looks confused and the other looks like it has accepted the situation. 💗

title: [CLASSIC] ZORUA [TEAL EYE] [POKEBUDDIES] ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[CLASSIC] ZORUA [TEAL EYE] [POKEBUDDIES] ENAMEL PIN

Zorua appears in MAMOBOT's PokéBuddies enamel line with bright teal eyes. A tiny fox who definitely has an alternate identity prepared.

title: [~SHINY GLITTERY] HORSEA ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY GLITTERY] HORSEA ENAMEL PIN

The independent artist also made a glittery shiny Horsea pin. Horsea saw the word “shiny” and decided to take it personally. ✨

title: [BLK NICKEL] RETRO PIKA ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[BLK NICKEL] RETRO PIKA ENAMEL PIN

This black-nickel Retro Pika pin comes from MAMOBOT's physical enamel collection. Pikachu appears to have found an old jacket and a fresh sense of confidence.

title: [SHINY] [BLK NICKEL ]MORPEKO ENAMELPIN [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]
caption:
[SHINY] [BLK NICKEL ]MORPEKO ENAMELPIN [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]

MAMOBOT released a shiny Morpeko pin with black-nickel finish through its Patreon line. Even the hardware looks like it's had a mood swing.

title: FLYGON [SHINY SANDSTORM] ENAMELPIN [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]
caption:
FLYGON [SHINY SANDSTORM] ENAMELPIN [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]

A shiny Flygon crosses MAMOBOT's enamel-pin world with a sandstorm theme. It looks like it could kick up dust inside a display case.

title: [MATCHA] HEART SWEET ALCREMIE [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN [MIXED GRADE] [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]
caption:
[MATCHA] HEART SWEET ALCREMIE [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN [MIXED GRADE] [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]

This matcha-colored Alcremie pin belongs to MAMOBOT's soft-dyed Pokémallow series. Dessert has become a wearable personality trait. 🍵

title: DARK GALVANTULA [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
DARK GALVANTULA [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

The artist gave Galvantula a dark-color Pokémallow enamel design. The spider got a makeover; the eight-leg situation remains.

title: [~SHINY] GALVANTULA [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY] GALVANTULA [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

This second Galvantula pin uses a shiny version in the same Pokémallow line. Apparently one electric spider was not enough for the jacket.

title: [~SHINY] FUECOCO [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY] FUECOCO [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

Shiny Fuecoco gets turned into a soft-dyed enamel pin by MAMOBOT. The tiny crocodile looks delighted to be anywhere at all.

title: PASTEL PINK MINCCINO [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
PASTEL PINK MINCCINO [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

The artist recolored Minccino in pastel pink for a physical Pokémallow pin. The cleaning Pokémon now looks like it would judge my laundry. 🎀

title: [~SHINY] FOMANTIS [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY] FOMANTIS [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

Fomantis shows up in its shiny colors in MAMOBOT's pin catalog. A garden pest with impeccable accessories.

title: [~SHINY] TANDEMAUS [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED [MIXED B GRADE] ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY] TANDEMAUS [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED [MIXED B GRADE] ENAMEL PIN

This shiny Tandemaus Pokémallow pin was sold in mixed B-grade condition, an actual production-grade detail on the listing. Even tiny enamel mice have factory seconds. Relatable.

title: [~SHINY GREEN APPLE GLITTER] APPLETUN [SWEET] [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY GREEN APPLE GLITTER] APPLETUN [SWEET] [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

MAMOBOT made a glittery green-apple shiny Appletun pin in its sweet-themed Pokémallow line. The pie dragon has achieved dessert and jewelry status simultaneously. 🍏

title: TCG DOODLE: BUBBLE MEWTWO ENAMELPIN  [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]
caption:
TCG DOODLE: BUBBLE MEWTWO ENAMELPIN  [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]

Bubble Mewtwo comes from MAMOBOT's TCG Doodle pin series, offered as a Patreon exclusive. Mewtwo has an intimidating resume and a deeply unserious bubble.

title: [~SHINY GREEN] TCG DOODLE: BUBBLE MEWTWO ENAMELPIN  [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]
caption:
[~SHINY GREEN] TCG DOODLE: BUBBLE MEWTWO ENAMELPIN  [PATREON EXCLUSIVE]

The maker produced a shiny-green take on the same Bubble Mewtwo physical pin. Somehow the bubble now looks more powerful.

title: [RAINBOW] GALARIAN PONYTA ENAMEL PIN [PRIDE] [POKEBUDDIES]
caption:
[RAINBOW] GALARIAN PONYTA ENAMEL PIN [PRIDE] [POKEBUDDIES]

A rainbow Galarian Ponyta appears in MAMOBOT's Pride PokéBuddies pin line. It was already a pastel unicorn. The rainbow was inevitable.

title: DIVA REGIROCK ENAMEL PIN
caption:
DIVA REGIROCK ENAMEL PIN

MAMOBOT's Diva Regirock is a gold-plated enamel pin. Regirock has left the cave and hired a stylist.

title: [~SHINY] STUNFISK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY] STUNFISK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

This shiny Stunfisk belongs to the artist's soft-dyed Pokémallow series. It looks exactly like a trap that wants compliments first.

title: APPLETUN [SWEET] [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
APPLETUN [SWEET] [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

Appletun appears in another sweet-themed enamel design from MAMOBOT. The wearable version is less likely to leave crumbs. Probably.

title: [~SHINY] PROFESSOR UMBREON SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EXCLUSIVE]
caption:
[~SHINY] PROFESSOR UMBREON SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EXCLUSIVE]

Professor Umbreon is a shiny Pokémallow pin released through the artist's Patreon catalog. Its office hours are after dark, obviously.

title: [~SHINY] PROFESSOR ESPEON SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EXCLUSIVE]
caption:
[~SHINY] PROFESSOR ESPEON SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EXCLUSIVE]

Professor Espeon gets the matching shiny pin treatment. The faculty meeting between these two must be unbearable.

title: [TAG TEAM!] GARDEVOIR & SYLVEON SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [DELUXE POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EARLY ACCESS ]
caption:
[TAG TEAM!] GARDEVOIR & SYLVEON SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [DELUXE POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EARLY ACCESS ]

MAMOBOT pairs Gardevoir and Sylveon in one deluxe soft-dyed Tag Team pin. That is a lot of elegance for two rubber pin backs.

title: [~SHINY] [TAG TEAM!] GARDEVOIR & SYLVEON SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [DELUXE POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EARLY ACCESS ]
caption:
[~SHINY] [TAG TEAM!] GARDEVOIR & SYLVEON SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [DELUXE POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EARLY ACCESS ]

The maker also did a shiny-color variant of its Gardevoir and Sylveon pair. They managed to become even more difficult to coordinate an outfit around.

title: [~SHINY] MEWTWO SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [DELUXE POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EARLY ACCESS ]
caption:
[~SHINY] MEWTWO SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [DELUXE POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EARLY ACCESS ]

A shiny Mewtwo joins MAMOBOT's larger deluxe Pokémallow enamel pieces. World-changing psychic power, now jacket-sized.

title: MEWTWO SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [DELUXE POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EARLY ACCESS ]
caption:
MEWTWO SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN  [DELUXE POKEMALLOW] [ PATREON EARLY ACCESS ]

The classic-color Mewtwo version sits beside the shiny variant in the artist's catalog. This one looks like it will grade the other pins.

title: MAUSHOLD SNOWMAN ENAMEL PIN [WINTER BUDDIES] [POKEBUDDIES] [IN HAND]
caption:
MAUSHOLD SNOWMAN ENAMEL PIN [WINTER BUDDIES] [POKEBUDDIES] [IN HAND]

MAMOBOT turned the Maushold family into a snowman-themed Winter Buddies pin. Four mice working together and still nobody has found a scarf. ☃️

title: WEEPINBELL [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
WEEPINBELL [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

Weepinbell gets a soft-dyed enamel pin in the maker's Pokémallow style. Its entire face says it has just heard bad news.

title: [~SHINY] PERSIAN [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN [PINK EAR]
caption:
[~SHINY] PERSIAN [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN [PINK EAR]

The shiny pink-ear Persian pin is another physical Pokémallow variant. Persian would absolutely insist this is its best side.

title: [HAPPY] MEOWTH [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[HAPPY] MEOWTH [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

MAMOBOT made a happy Meowth pin rather than the usual scheming expression. It has either found money or is about to ask me for some.

title: [~SHINY PINK LOG] KOMALA [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY PINK LOG] KOMALA [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

Shiny Komala clings to a pink log in this Pokémallow pin. Even its furniture got the alternate colorway.

title: KOMALA [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
KOMALA [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

The normal Komala version keeps the sleepy Pokémon and its log together. I also have a piece of furniture I refuse to let go of. Mine is the couch.

title: LEBQ Pikachu brick figure box
caption:
LEBQ Pikachu brick figure box

LEBQ put Ash and Pikachu on a Pokémon GO brick-figure box photographed in a 2018 bootleg review. The logos are loud enough to distract from the toy. Almost.

title: [SANTA] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[SANTA] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

A Santa-hat Psyduck pin came out of MAMOBOT's holiday Pokémallow designs. Holiday planning has given Psyduck the exact face I expected. 🎅

title: LEBQ Squirtle brick figure box
caption:
LEBQ Squirtle brick figure box

Another LEBQ box pairs its blocky trainer with Squirtle in the unlicensed Pokémon GO brick line. The package promises Pokémon. The shell paint negotiates.

title: LEBQ Bulbasaur brick figure box
caption:
LEBQ Bulbasaur brick figure box

This LEBQ package shows the Bulbasaur side of the same photographed bootleg figure assortment. The box is far more confident than the paint job.

title: LEBQ tiny Pikachu brick figure
caption:
LEBQ tiny Pikachu brick figure

The 2018 LEBQ review also photographed a tiny brick-built Pikachu by itself. It is a surprisingly compact electrical hazard.

title: LEBQ Pikachu and Poliwhirl figures
caption:
LEBQ Pikachu and Poliwhirl figures

The reviewer put LEBQ's Pikachu next to its Poliwhirl figure, showing the uneven paint and plastic of the physical toys. Poliwhirl looks like it has questions about its career path.

title: LEBQ Charmander and Squirtle figures
caption:
LEBQ Charmander and Squirtle figures

Charmander and Squirtle were photographed together from that same LEBQ bootleg assortment. The elemental rivalry survived. The quality control did not.

title: LEBQ Clefairy and Bulbasaur figures
caption:
LEBQ Clefairy and Bulbasaur figures

The LEBQ figures include a little Clefairy and Bulbasaur pair shown in the 2018 review. Clefairy seems delighted; Bulbasaur seems aware of the budget.

title: [ SLOWPOKE] [HEADACHE]  PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[ SLOWPOKE] [HEADACHE]  PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

MAMOBOT made a Psyduck party-hat pin with a Slowpoke-themed headache gag. Two famously unhurried Pokémon have somehow created stress.

title: [DIGLETT] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[DIGLETT] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

One of the artist's party-hat Psyducks wears a Diglett-inspired hat. A headache on top of a headache, but make it collectible.

title: [RAINBOW] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[RAINBOW] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

The rainbow variant adds another costume to MAMOBOT's growing party-hat Psyduck line. Psyduck still doesn't know whose birthday it is.

title: [SILLY] [PINK WAVE HAT]  PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[SILLY] [PINK WAVE HAT]  PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

This silly Psyduck pin has a pink wave hat in the maker's soft-dyed Pokémallow series. The hat says party; the face says please lower the music.

title: [SILLY] [BLUE WAVE HAT]  PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[SILLY] [BLUE WAVE HAT]  PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

A blue-wave version of the same physical pin followed in the artist's catalog. Psyduck has changed hats and solved none of its problems.

title: [TEAL] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[TEAL] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

MAMOBOT also gave party-hat Psyduck a teal-color variant. At this point its closet is mostly hats and aspirin.

title: [SWABLU] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[SWABLU] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

A Swablu-themed party hat turns Psyduck into a tiny crossover of two Pokémon. The hat looks comfortable. The wearer looks unconvinced.

title: LEBQ Bulbasaur figure
caption:
LEBQ Bulbasaur figure

A close-up from the 2018 bootleg review shows LEBQ's physical Bulbasaur figure, including its sparse back paint. The bulb got a color budget. The back did not.

title: [~PINK DITTO] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN [PINKDITTO]
caption:
[~PINK DITTO] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN [PINKDITTO]

This pink-Ditto variant is another party-hat Psyduck enamel pin from MAMOBOT. I have stopped asking how many parties Psyduck attends.

title: [~CLASSIC] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~CLASSIC] PARTY HAT PSYDUCK [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

MAMOBOT's classic party-hat Psyduck is the baseline for all those unusual color variants. The original headache, now with celebratory trim.

title: [~CLASSIC] PARTY HAT MUDKIP [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~CLASSIC] PARTY HAT MUDKIP [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

The party-hat idea reached Mudkip in MAMOBOT's Pokémallow pin series. Mudkip appears much more prepared for a party than Psyduck.

title: [~SHINY] PARTY HAT MUDKIP [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN
caption:
[~SHINY] PARTY HAT MUDKIP [POKEMALLOW]  SOFT DYED ENAMEL PIN

The shiny Mudkip variant gives that little party hat a new colorway. No thoughts, just excellent tiny birthday energy. 🎉

title: [3 PC SET] [~SHINY] REUNICLUS FAMILY [POKEMALLOW] SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN [ PATREON EXCLUSIVE]
caption:
[3 PC SET] [~SHINY] REUNICLUS FAMILY [POKEMALLOW] SOFT DYED ENAMELPIN [ PATREON EXCLUSIVE]

MAMOBOT offered a three-piece shiny Reuniclus family enamel set through its Patreon line. A whole cellular family reunion on a pin board.

title: Tuff Puff - Pixel Jigglypuff Sticker
caption:
Tuff Puff - Pixel Jigglypuff Sticker

Artist KA LI made Tuff Puff as a water-resistant physical Jigglypuff pixel sticker for Calamori Designs. Jigglypuff would be furious that a sticker cannot actually sing.

title: Dittonite & Mosslax - Pixel Pokopia Keychains
caption:
Dittonite & Mosslax - Pixel Pokopia Keychains

Calamori Designs turned Dittonite and Mosslax into double-sided acrylic pixel keychains. Two little creatures ready to hang from keys they cannot operate.

title: Surf's Up Pika! Button Pin
caption:
Surf's Up Pika! Button Pin

Surf's Up Pika is a physical button pin from KA LI's pixel-art merch line. Pikachu brought a board. I hope the ocean brought surge protection. 🌊

title: Pixel Pokopia Stickers
caption:
Pixel Pokopia Stickers

The artist printed these Pokopia-inspired pixel designs as physical stickers. Tiny game-style creatures, now capable of colonizing a laptop.

title: Pokemon Value Bundle (save 35%)
caption:
Pokemon Value Bundle (save 35%)

Calamori Designs bundled several of its Pokémon-themed physical products into one pack. The sensible collector move was to buy one item. The bundle disagrees.

title: Floatie Psyduck - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Floatie Psyduck - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

Floatie Psyduck is a double-sided clear acrylic keychain made by KA LI. Swimming lessons feel ambitious for someone whose entire expression is “wait.”

title: Pixel Mega Starmie Mini Sticker
caption:
Pixel Mega Starmie Mini Sticker

Mega Starmie became a miniature pixel sticker in the Calamori catalog. There are somehow even more points on the star now.

title: Mew - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Mew - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

KA LI made a little pixel Mew as a clear acrylic keychain. The rarest Pokémon in the room is now attached to house keys.

title: Cyndaquil - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Cyndaquil - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

Cyndaquil gets its own pixel-art keychain from the same artist. A pocket-sized fire starter hanging next to your car fob.

title: Umbreon - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Umbreon - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

Umbreon joins Calamori's acrylic pixel keychain line. Its preferred operating hours are probably after your keys go missing.

title: Espeon - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Espeon - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

The matching Espeon keychain sits in the artist's pixel collection. Between Espeon and Umbreon, one of them should know where I left the keys.

title: Tepig - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Tepig - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

Tepig becomes a tiny acrylic keychain in KA LI's pixel style. The little pig has been assigned full-time bag duty.

title: Chikorita - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Chikorita - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

Chikorita gets a pixel keychain with its familiar big leaf. The leaf is still doing most of the visual work. 🌱

title: Totodile - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Totodile - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

Totodile appears as a small double-sided acrylic keychain. Those teeth are now closer to my pocket than I would prefer.

title: Oshawott - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Oshawott - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

Oshawott rounds out another part of the artist's pixel starter lineup. The shell looks ready for a dramatic keychain battle.

title: UPDATED: #152+ Pixel Pokemon Mini Stickers (Individual)
caption:
UPDATED: #152+ Pixel Pokemon Mini Stickers (Individual)

Calamori's mini-sticker series extends beyond number 152 with individual physical pixel Pokémon. This is what happens when “I'll just get my favorites” meets an entire Pokédex.

title: Pixel Psyduck Resort Stickers
caption:
Pixel Psyduck Resort Stickers

KA LI printed a Psyduck resort scene as a physical pixel sticker. Psyduck is on vacation and still looks like it forgot to turn the stove off.

title: Pixel Psyduck Sticker Bundle
caption:
Pixel Psyduck Sticker Bundle

The Psyduck sticker bundle collects several of the artist's resort-style designs. A complete holiday itinerary for a Pokémon that wants to lie down.

title: Pixel Pokemon Mystery Sticker Pack
caption:
Pixel Pokemon Mystery Sticker Pack

Calamori packages surprise selections of its physical pixel Pokémon stickers as a mystery pack. I would absolutely open it and immediately negotiate with the duplicates.

title: #1-151 Pixel Kanto Pokemon Mini Stickers (Individual)
caption:
#1-151 Pixel Kanto Pokemon Mini Stickers (Individual)

The artist also made individual mini stickers for all 151 original Kanto Pokémon. A tiny sticker Pokédex is a dangerous thing to show a completionist.

title: Shiny Magikarp - Pixel Pokemon Enamel Pin
caption:
Shiny Magikarp - Pixel Pokemon Enamel Pin

KA LI turned shiny Magikarp into a gold-plated hard-enamel pin, playing off the old in-game Magikarp sales pitch. Five hundred Pokédollars seems steep until it learns to be a dragon. 🐟

title: Dragonite - Pixel Pokemon Keychain
caption:
Dragonite - Pixel Pokemon Keychain

Dragonite gets a pixel acrylic keychain in the Calamori collection. A mail carrier would have been a reasonable career. It chose key duty.

title: Delivery Dragonite - Pixel Pokemon Enamel Pin
caption:
Delivery Dragonite - Pixel Pokemon Enamel Pin

The separate Delivery Dragonite design is a physical enamel pin by the same artist. Finally, a delivery service whose tracking update I might believe. 📦

title: Togepi Pokemon 3D Printed Fidget Clicker | Sensory Toy | ADHD Focus Tool | Pokemon Fan Gift
caption:
Togepi Pokemon 3D Printed Fidget Clicker | Sensory Toy | ADHD Focus Tool | Pokemon Fan Gift

Sydney maker ByLandy 3D-prints this Togepi as a pocket-size fidget clicker. The egg Pokémon has become a button I can press. Togepi may have questions.

title: Pikachu SVP 085 Fan Card, Custom Pokemon Trading Card | Pokemon Fan Gift, Collector Gift for Him | Australian Made
caption:
Pikachu SVP 085 Fan Card, Custom Pokemon Trading Card | Pokemon Fan Gift, Collector Gift for Him | Australian Made

ByLandy prints a physical Pikachu 085-inspired fan card in its Sydney studio; the listing identifies it as a custom display piece. It belongs in a fan-art binder. A real promo-card slot would be a very confusing place for it.

title: Blastoise ex 200/165 Fan Card, Custom Pokemon Trading Card | Pokemon Fan Gift, Collector Gift for Him | Australian Made
caption:
Blastoise ex 200/165 Fan Card, Custom Pokemon Trading Card | Pokemon Fan Gift, Collector Gift for Him | Australian Made

A Blastoise ex 200/165-inspired fan card is another handmade printed display piece from ByLandy. The cannon turtle now has an alternate career in interior decoration.

title: Jigglypuff Window Decor, Pokemon Room Decor, 3D Printed Pokemon Gift, Gaming Room Decor, Kids Bedroom Decor
caption:
Jigglypuff Window Decor, Pokemon Room Decor, 3D Printed Pokemon Gift, Gaming Room Decor, Kids Bedroom Decor

ByLandy 3D-prints Jigglypuff-shaped window decor for a Pokémon-themed room. If it starts singing, shut the blinds. 🎤

title: Charmander Window Decor, 3D Printed Pokemon Figure | Fan Gift for Him, Gaming Room Decor | Australian Made Handmade
caption:
Charmander Window Decor, 3D Printed Pokemon Figure | Fan Gift for Him, Gaming Room Decor | Australian Made Handmade

The Sydney shop also makes a 3D-printed Charmander window decoration. ByLandy made it as a physical collectible. Keeping it near curtains feels like tempting fate.

title: Pikachu Window Decor, Pokemon Room Decor, 3D Printed Pokemon Gift, Gaming Room Decor, Kids Bedroom Decor
caption:
Pikachu Window Decor, Pokemon Room Decor, 3D Printed Pokemon Gift, Gaming Room Decor, Kids Bedroom Decor

Pikachu gets its own physical window piece in ByLandy's decor collection. At least the window can survive a Thunderbolt better than my phone.

title: Eevee Window Decor, Pokemon Room Decor, 3D Printed Pokemon Gift, Gaming Room Decor, Kids Bedroom Decor
caption:
Eevee Window Decor, Pokemon Room Decor, 3D Printed Pokemon Gift, Gaming Room Decor, Kids Bedroom Decor

Eevee appears in the same handmade window-decor line. It's a physical fan piece from ByLandy. Eight evolutions, one very specific spot on the glass.

title: 3D Printed Pokemon Planter: Desk Decor for 90s Kids
caption:
3D Printed Pokemon Planter: Desk Decor for 90s Kids

ByLandy 3D-prints a Pokémon-inspired planter for a desk. Bulbasaur would appreciate the effort and then critique my watering schedule.

title: 3D Printed Pikachu Fidget Clicker: Stress Relief Toy
caption:
3D Printed Pikachu Fidget Clicker: Stress Relief Toy

A Pikachu fidget clicker is another practical 3D-printed object from ByLandy. I can now annoy myself with a tiny electric mascot instead of a pen.

title: Mega Charizard ex 125/094 Fan Card, Custom Pokemon Trading Card | Pokemon Fan Gift, Collector Gift for Him | Australian Made
caption:
Mega Charizard ex 125/094 Fan Card, Custom Pokemon Trading Card | Pokemon Fan Gift, Collector Gift for Him | Australian Made

This Mega Charizard ex-inspired fan card is a physical, handmade display collectible printed in Sydney. Its source is ByLandy's shop of handmade fan work. The firepower is fictional; the temptation to misfile it is real.

title: Pokeball Vase, 3D Printed Pokémon Flower Holder | Gaming Room Decor, Pokemon Fan Gift for Him | Handmade in Australia
caption:
Pokeball Vase, 3D Printed Pokémon Flower Holder | Gaming Room Decor, Pokemon Fan Gift for Him | Handmade in Australia

ByLandy turned a Poké Ball shape into a 3D-printed flower vase. A Pokémon collectible has finally learned to hold water. 💐

title: Manga Pokemon Trading Card | Pokemon Fan Art | Anime Style Collectible
caption:
Manga Pokemon Trading Card | Pokemon Fan Art | Anime Style Collectible

The maker's manga-style fan card is printed as a physical collectible rather than a playable TCG release. The object comes from ByLandy's handmade Pokémon line. A binder can enjoy it. A tournament judge probably cannot.

title: Snorlax Stand for Google Home Mini | 3D Printed Pokemon Smart Home Decor | Fan Gift for Him | Australian Made
caption:
Snorlax Stand for Google Home Mini | 3D Printed Pokemon Smart Home Decor | Fan Gift for Him | Australian Made

A 3D-printed Snorlax stand holds a Google Home Mini in ByLandy's catalog. This may be the first Snorlax whose job is to listen when you talk.

title: Custom Picnic Poke Terrarium
caption:
Custom Picnic Poke Terrarium

PokePoke Designs offers a handmade picnic terrarium with little food, flowers, and an optional checkered blanket. The Pokémon gets a better lunch spot than I do. 🧺

title: Pocket Monster Kit figure blister
caption:
Pocket Monster Kit figure blister

The Pocket Monster Kit was documented by bootleg collector Chris Doyle as a 1999 California find: one enormous blister card holding 19 badly recolored figures. Green Meowth looks like he knows who made it and refuses to talk.

title: Custom Graveyard Terrarium
caption:
Custom Graveyard Terrarium

PokePoke Designs' custom graveyard terrarium surrounds a ghost or dark-type partner with tombstones, bones, a spooky tree, and a Cubone skull. Finally, a nice relaxing place to keep a Gengar.

title: Clues & Monster Pokémon and Blue’s Clues blister
caption:
Clues & Monster Pokémon and Blue’s Clues blister

Chris Doyle documented this 1998 California bootleg called Clues & Monster, which put Ash and Pikachu on the same blister card as several Blue's Clues characters. The crossover nobody pitched, yet someone manufactured.

title: Custom Beach Poke Terrarium
caption:
Custom Beach Poke Terrarium

A custom beach scene is one of PokePoke Designs' handmade Pokémon terrarium options. A tiny vacation destination with no room for a beach chair.

title: Custom Volcano Poke Terrarium
caption:
Custom Volcano Poke Terrarium

The maker offers a volcano environment for a Pokémon partner inside a display dome. It's a physical fan piece from PokePoke Designs. I hope the miniature homeowners bought fire insurance. 🌋

title: Snowy Winter Terrarium
caption:
Snowy Winter Terrarium

PokePoke Designs built a snowy winter landscape as another custom habitat. The small scene makes me want to hand its Pokémon a scarf.

title: Winter Wonderland Snowglobe Terrarium
caption:
Winter Wonderland Snowglobe Terrarium

The winter-wonderland snowglobe terrarium is a separate physical option from the same maker. PokePoke Designs made it as a physical collectible. If the Pokémon inside hates winter, this is a remarkably elaborate prank.

title: Wall Hangable Hexagon Terrariums
caption:
Wall Hangable Hexagon Terrariums

These hexagon terrariums by PokePoke Designs can hang on the wall or sit on a shelf. A Pokémon home with a mounting option and absolutely no lease agreement.

title: Vibrating Pikachu pull-string keychain
caption:
Vibrating Pikachu pull-string keychain

A collector documented this small vibrating Pikachu keychain in 1999; it shook when its pull string retracted and came in a plain cellophane bag. The pull ring's location is unfortunate. Pikachu has endured enough.
